title: The dock, 11:30 PM
logline: Someone has to make sure the fog doesn't get stolen.

panels.composition: Tier 1: 11:30 PM on the dock. The reception glowing behind them in pale gold. CHLOE has kicked off her heels; her gown trails slightly on the wet cedar planks. WOOD sits beside her, suit jacket balled under his arm. A long panoramic tier: the two of them looking across dark water toward the lights of Vancouver Island.

characters.pose: sitting on the dock edge, jacket balled under his arm
sitting beside him, heels off, gown on the wet planks
